composition_rationale: All three certified modules are composed rather than generated. agent-runtime supplies respond() against the roster contract (grounded answering, automated self-identification, refuse-and-escalate); persistence-core supplies the table-registry store so conversations and messages persist as structured records with approval metadata; chat-shell supplies the analyst chat UI wired to POST /chat, extended in-slice with history, search and the draft approval control. Because the skeleton, data layer, agent host and UI arrive pre-certified, each of the five planned slices is an incremental feature build rather than a from-scratch layer, holding every slice well under its $3.00 node cap and the whole build plan at $6.90 against the $25.00 run envelope. Clarifications applied: embedded documents (no external KB connector to build), local accounts (no SSO integration), indefinite retention (no purge job), manual copy of approved replies (no email/ticketing integration) — each removes build scope and is why deploy_target stays 'local'.
